Hey, just heard about this ruling from the Punjab and Haryana High Court where Justice Sumeet Goel said anticipatory bail can't be cancelled just on non-recovery of stolen articles or how serious the allegations are. He claimed it only takes clear proof of misuse of liberty or supervening circumstances, and he dismissed the plea to cancel the pre-arrest bail in that house case.

This is the elites pulling strings again—the courts are actively shielding their insiders with these rigged technicalities, treating theft and serious crimes like no big deal so the real players stay untouchable. It's a coordinated setup to protect the connected ones with pre-arrest deals while the rest of us eat the consequences. They dress it up as law, but it's obvious the whole thing is designed to keep the hidden manipulation going and the system locked in their favor.
